name: Chingona Ventures
tagline: First checks for fearless, overlooked founders
rundown: Chingona Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm that writes first checks into founders building in large, fast-growing but overlooked markets — fintech, the future of work, healthcare, and the Latino economy among them. It's known for backing scrappy, mission-driven teams that traditional VCs often pass on.

timeline.event: Samara Mejia Hernandez founds Chingona Ventures to back overlooked, early-stage founders.
The firm raises a substantially larger second fund to widen its pre-seed and seed investing.

notableFacts: "Chingona" is Spanish slang for a bold, badass woman — the firm leans into backing gutsy founders.
It typically writes first checks at the pre-seed and seed stage.
Its focus areas include fintech, the future of work, healthcare, and the Latino economy.
